name: Takamori Sana
source:
A childhood friend who is one year older than the protagonist. No matter what, she’s always nagging the protagonist about this and that, but deep down, she can’t stop thinking about him, yet she just can’t bring herself to tell him how she feels.

Her slender figure is certainly nothing to be self-conscious about compared to other women her age, but she seems to be bothered by the presence of Yuu and Kimika.

Since she’s inexperienced, she’s a bit clumsy at first during sex, but her inability to be open and honest leads her to say harsh things without meaning to.

However, she cares about the protagonist more than anyone else. Driven solely by the desire to make him feel good, she always gives it her all.

[From [url=https://syrup-soft.com/hs/chuforyou/chara.html#sana]official site[/url]]
